name: Station clock loss-of-sync alarm
aliases: substations Substation timing and event interfaces
summary: Reports loss of the station clock's accepted synchronization condition.
description: Reports loss of the station clock's accepted synchronization condition. A station time system provides a shared time reference for protection records, measurements and automation. Different devices can use different timing protocols, so the time source, distribution path and quality information must remain identifiable.

In a substation, a station clock can provide precision timing to process equipment and another timing interface to event recorders. The alarm system should distinguish loss of a distribution path from loss of the external time source. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Clock synchronization health” at the input and “Station clock alarm” at the output. The clock may continue providing holdover outputs.
